title: Answer Order Calls After Hours
summary: A phone line that answers order-status and policy calls when your team is off, and passes the hard ones to a person.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you get after-hours order calls; the value is fewer missed calls and a summary each morning.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Your team starts the day with a summary, not a voicemail pile.
who_its_for: Online shops with customers who call after hours.
Small teams without a phone desk.

stack.name: Shop Phone Line Bot
stack.role: Checks order status for verified callers and answers from your policies.
stack.creator: dean oakford

stack.name: After-Hours Front Desk
stack.role: Takes the after-hours contact and records the request.
stack.creator: John Shetler

steps.name: Shop Phone Line Bot
steps.does: Checks the order for a verified caller and answers from your policy

steps.name: After-Hours Front Desk
steps.does: Takes the after-hours call and logs the request

outputs: A result you review before it is used

steps: Set your shop policies and the verified-caller rule.
Connect the phone line and the order lookup.
Review the call summaries each morning.
Move the hard calls to a person.
guardrails: The bot never takes payments or changes orders without your yes.
Keep a person on the escalation path.
